main_text.p: ramum Abbatem Ϙίκτελον. Μεΐζων, (quod etiam μέγαν) major, Anglicè, mara: ut Mat.XI. mara Johanne Ful-whitere: major Jóh.Baptistâ: & mox, ꝑ bῑth mara: eft illo major. Μέγιστος, maximus, nunc most, quod olim mar-stan. In mara, τὸ s folemne eft comparativi Saxonici characteristicum, idque Græcorum, ut infrà videbimus, imitatione.

Μιχρός, ελάσσων, ελάχιστος. Pro μικροῦ, aliud ejusdem ferè significationis substantivum Græcum substituerunt Angli: Λάττ, little. Comparativum & superlativum idem retinuerunt: ἐλάσσων, lesse: ἐλάχιστος, lest. Videbuntur for-tasse imperitis infolentiores ejusmodi contractiones verborum, ἐλάχιστος, lest. at nos posteà, quæ magis mirentur, de quibus tamen nulla potest esse controversia, proferemus.

Notissimus apud Græcos & ufitatissimus comparandi typus, ut comparativus definitur in ἐς; superlativus in τῶ: quod hodieque, quantum ad characte-risticas literas attinet, retinent Angli: Long, longer, longest. Short, shorter, shortest. Atq; ita veteres Angli seni-or fer

page.notes: Marginal note at right: "10" beside top line. Printed text is in Greek and Latin mix; Greek words transcribed as best legible. Lower lines partly obscured; last word "fer" is cut at the page foot ("senior"). Some words uncertain.
